author: Animalogic
description:
Get ready to shrink down to the macro scale as we explore Earth's most alien-looking, multi-legged, and predatory invertebrates. From backyard predators to deep-sea nightmares, this compilation covers the mind-blowing adaptations that have allowed these creatures to conquer almost every corner of the globe.

00:00 Mantis: The Ultimate Assassin
08:42 Cockroaches Are Cuter Than You Think
16:35 Weaver Ants: Nature’s Engineers
23:30 Wasps: The Literal Worst
34:39 Diving Beetles: All-Natural Scuba Divers
40:18 Are Locusts Worse Than Mosquitoes?
57:58 Centipedes: The Ultimate Nopes
01:05:46 Bobbit Worms: Zero Legs, Pure Nightmare Fuel
01:12:17 Millipedes Used to Be Over 6 Feet Long
01:18:43 Velvet Worms: Straight From Another Planet
